About.title: About us
About.intro: Midad is an Arabic-first platform for practical learning: courses taught by instructors who practise what they teach, with bilingual content and certificates anyone can verify by code.
About.missionBody: There is a lot of Arabic educational content, but little of it explains how work actually gets done. We build courses that start from a real problem at work and end with a skill you can apply, not a set of concepts forgotten a week later.
About.methodBody: Every course is reviewed before publication: clear learning objectives, a progressive curriculum, and lessons with a stated duration. Free preview lessons are labelled clearly so you know what you are buying before you pay.
About.verifyBody: A certificate is issued after the course requirements are met and carries a unique code that opens a verification page showing the recipient, the course and the issue date. Anyone with the code can confirm it is genuine.
About.teamBody: A small team working with independent instructors: we review the content, help with production, and follow up on learner questions. Nothing is published without a human review.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.intro: Direct answers to what people ask most before enrolling. If your question is missing, contact us.
Faq.q1: Can I preview a course before buying?
Faq.a1: Yes. Every course shows one or more free preview lessons, with each lesson's duration in the curriculum. You can watch the preview without creating an account.
Faq.a2: Payment runs through Stripe with test or live cards once the key is configured. We never store card details on our servers.
Faq.a3: The certificate documents that you completed the course requirements on Midad and carries a unique verification code. It is not a university degree or a professional licence, and we do not claim otherwise.
Faq.q4: How do I get a refund?
Faq.a4: Within 14 days of purchase, with less than 30% progress and no issued certificate, request a refund from your dashboard. An admin reviews it and Stripe executes the refund on approval.
Faq.q5: Can I take a course in a different language from the site?
Faq.a5: The course language is independent of the interface language: a course may be in Arabic while you use the English interface, and the reverse. Each course states its language on its page and in the catalog.
Faq.q6: How do I become an instructor?
Faq.a6: Apply from the “Teach on Midad” page with your experience, field and a link to a sample of your work. The team reviews the application and replies with a decision and its reason; you can reapply after a rejection.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: By using Midad you agree to these terms. They are written as clearly as possible and are not a substitute for legal advice.
Terms.accountBody: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for activity under your account. Sharing an account, reselling content, or attempting to bypass access controls is not allowed. An account may be suspended for misuse, with the reason stated.
Terms.purchasesBody: Prices are in Saudi riyals and include what is shown on the checkout page. Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase with less than 30% progress and no issued certificate, and are executed by the payment provider after admin approval.
Terms.contentBody: Content is owned by the instructor or licensed to them, and your licence is personal and non-transferable. The platform keeps your purchased courses available while your account is active, even if a course is removed from the catalog.
Terms.changesBody: We may update these terms as the product or regulations change. The new version is published on this page, and a material change is announced in the platform before it takes effect.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: We collect the minimum data needed to run the platform. Here is what we collect and why.
Privacy.dataBody: Account data (name, email, an uploaded photo if you choose one, language and theme), learning records (enrollments, progress, quiz attempts, notes), purchase records (orders and payments), and the messages you send to support.
Privacy.useBody: To run your account, deliver the courses you bought, issue certificates, answer your questions, and send the notifications you opted into. We do not sell your data to anyone.
Privacy.sharingBody: The payment provider to complete a purchase or refund, the email provider to send verification and notification mail, and the hosting provider to run the service. Each share is limited to what the purpose requires.
Privacy.rightsBody: You can export your data as JSON from account settings, edit your details, or delete your account (a soft delete that preserves financial records). For questions, contact the support team.
